metaDescription: Join Penn KDSAP without an application: subscribe to the listserv, attend general training, and volunteer or attend professional development events.
title: Learn through service, teamwork, and community partnership
summary: Penn KDSAP gives undergraduates a structured way to support community programs while learning from peers and physicians. There is no application for general membership.
heroImageAlt: Penn students gathered around a volunteer training demonstration
sectionTitle: Join Penn KDSAP in three steps

objectives.title: 1. Join the listserv
objectives.text: Subscribe for training announcements, screening sign-ups, professional development opportunities, and chapter updates.

objectives.title: 2. Attend general training
objectives.text: Complete a general training session to prepare for volunteer responsibilities at community screenings.

objectives.title: 3. Get involved
objectives.text: Volunteer at screenings and attend panels, workshops, and other professional development events.
